primary_result_required: 2026_track_b_score_v1.json, sealed and matched to the same frozen forecast-year archive
population: All 213 sealed strict-QC forecast leads, identical M0-M4 cases and common valid daily-source cells; no outcome-dependent case selection
daily_grid_contract: 125 official-domain POST files, 2026-06-01 through 2026-10-03, each 129x135 little-endian float32; crop to 10-22 N and 68-80 E; finite 0-10000 mm cells only; negatives/missing remain masked
provisional_source_warning: A 2025 same-day test found 330/4964 valid cells differ from annual RF25; this source cannot substitute for the primary annual NetCDF or be described as final truth.
probability_rule: Exclude all 22 frozen incoherent leads from probability metrics, retain all for deterministic M0-M4 comparison
version_rule: Report the announced June 15 boundary as a sensitivity stratum, never as proof of actual rollout or model equivalence
promotion_rule: No promotion from this provisional source regardless of diagnostic metric values
